finding: P38 must remain fixture/dashboard QA automation only, not model evaluation.
fix: Script boundaries and report text explicitly state no model, checkpoint, dashboard runtime, or extension runtime is called.

finding: QA must fail if one machine has fewer or more than 12 fixture rows unless a deficit is explicit.
fix: Script groups fixtures by machine and asserts 12 rows for PromptToTask, OrchestrationReasoning, and SkillSelection.

finding: Artifact presence is not enough; every fixture needs a matching dashboard/API scenario and P37 human label.
fix: Script builds fixture_id maps and rejects missing or orphan scenarios and labels.

finding: Dashboard QA must check labels and visible result text, not only IDs.
fix: Script validates human_label_ru, human_api_name_ru, plain_explanation_ru, input examples, expected visible result, debug fields, and evidence boundary text.

finding: Rows must not quietly enable training, eval execution, or raw private text copying.
fix: Script asserts universal_only=true, raw_private_text_copied=false, training_allowed=false, eval_execution_allowed=false, and not_executed_yet=true where applicable.

finding: P36/P37 artifacts must not claim semantic quality, live runtime, checkpoint mutation, promotion, or host runtime.
fix: Script scans structured flags and positive overclaim phrases while allowing honest negated boundary wording.

finding: Fixture rows could accidentally reuse source families within a machine, weakening future eval design.
fix: Script checks heldout_source_family uniqueness per machine.

finding: A PASS report is not acceptable if files contain mojibake, escaped Cyrillic, CRLF, or question-mark runs.
fix: Script scans P36/P37 inputs; separate verification scans P38 artifacts and state.
